title: Frames (first/last base64 thumbnails)
description: First and last frame thumbnails per shot, embedded as base64 JPEG data URIs so the asset stays self-contained. Producer: html/gen_timeline_html.py:extract_frames_if_needed (extracts via ffmpeg, encodes JPEG as data URI).

id.description: Matches the id field in shots.json.

first_frame.description: First frame of the shot as a base64 JPEG data URI (prefix is always data:image/jpeg;base64,).

last_frame.description: Last frame of the shot as a base64 JPEG data URI (prefix is always data:image/jpeg;base64,).
